draft: Launch fields only, read by scripts/agent-harness.mjs (#48); the full schema and its conformance cases are #312's.

signIn.readBy: a run is BLOCKED until the agent is signed in
signIn.signedIn: stdout is JSON with loggedIn true

session.readBy: scripted sessions run interactively in a pseudo-terminal, never with -p, which ends async hooks at teardown

readOnlyJob.readBy: DeepBuild's own jobs: only the MCP servers they need, none of the checkout's settings, no bypass flag, prompt on stdin

usage.readBy: every run prints its cost and is held to its cap
usage.costFrom: the status line's cost.total_cost_usd in a session, the result event's total_cost_usd in a job
usage.tokens: assistant entries' message.usage, once per message.id, since each content block repeats it; input is input_tokens plus cache_creation_input_tokens, cached is cache_read_input_tokens

transcripts.readBy: a run keeps its session's own transcript
transcripts.path: projects/{cwd with each non-alphanumeric character as -}/{session}.jsonl
